name: Chapter Batch Export
changes: The Pro fields, the preset list and Save preset of the export window can now be selected without Pro. They show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. No option changes and nothing is saved.
tip: Set a root chapter range such as '1-3, 5' to export only those chapters with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Chapter Batch Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
